categories.main_business_segments: Taiwan Pelican Express primarily operates in nationwide parcel delivery and warehousing logistics services. Its business segments include parcel delivery services (B2C and C2C) with offerings such as regular temperature, low temperature, reverse logistics, same-day delivery, airport luggage delivery, smart lockers, and cash on delivery. The logistics segment provides comprehensive supply chain solutions including warehousing, inventory management, transportation, installation services, and value-added services for industries like e-commerce, health foods, consumer goods, electronics, and appliances.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages information technology as its core competitive advantage, employing smart logistics development including automated route planning systems, barcode automatic reading equipment at transfer centers, and AIoT-based fleet management for real-time driver behavior monitoring. It has developed a low-temperature monitoring system to ensure cold chain compliance and has implemented high-efficiency automated sorting systems in its logistics centers. Taiwan Pelican Express also holds patents such as the non-cash cash-on-delivery system and maintains ISO27001 information security certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large e-commerce platforms, TV shopping companies, retail chains, convenience stores, and manufacturers in sectors such as health foods, daily necessities, cosmetics, home appliances, and 3C products. The company serves both individual consumers and corporate clients, including government projects like pandemic prevention package delivery. Its major client is Fubon Media Technology, accounting for approximately 22.84% of consolidated revenue. The company also targets emerging markets such as cross-border e-commerce and cold chain logistics for vaccines and medical supplies.
categories.geographic_coverage: Taiwan Pelican Express operates primarily within Taiwan, covering the entire island with a dense network of service points and logistics centers. It also has overseas investments and subsidiaries in Singapore (Pelecanus Express Pte. Ltd.) and Vietnam (Pelican Express Vietnam Co., Ltd.) focusing on warehousing and logistics services. The company provides specialized services at Taiwan's major airports including Taoyuan and Songshan airports.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing last-mile delivery services, warehousing, inventory management, and integrated logistics solutions. It acts as a logistics service provider connecting manufacturers, e-commerce platforms, retail chains, and end consumers, including value-added services like installation and reverse logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening information technology integration to enhance smart logistics capabilities, expanding cold chain logistics services with GDP certification, and supporting large retail chains' online transformation. The company emphasizes digital transformation, automation of sorting and routing, and green logistics initiatives to achieve sustainability goals. It also plans to expand cross-border e-commerce logistics and invest in automated transfer and warehousing centers to improve operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from parcel delivery and logistics services, including B2C and B2B delivery, warehousing, installation, and value-added logistics solutions. Additional income streams include cash-on-delivery fees, rental income from smart lockers, and sales of packaging materials. The company also earns revenue from strategic partnerships and government contracts related to pandemic prevention logistics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Taiwan Pelican Express competes with major domestic parcel and logistics providers such as Uni-President Express, Hsinchu Logistics, Kerry TJ Logistics, and Chunghwa Post, as well as regional and emerging shared platform operators. It holds a strong market position with a comprehensive nationwide network, advanced IT systems, and diversified service offerings, particularly in cold chain and integrated logistics, differentiating itself in a highly competitive and labor-intensive industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.51 billion in 2022, representing a 1% year-over-year growth. Net profit after tax was NT$176 million, a decline of 26.6% compared to the previous year, mainly due to increased operating costs. Total assets stood at about NT$4.57 billion with equity of NT$2.2 billion. The company maintains steady growth momentum despite challenges such as rising labor and fuel costs and market competition, with ongoing investments in automation and fleet upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Taiwan Pelican Express emphasizes its dense nationwide network, comprehensive service portfolio including cold chain and last-mile delivery, and strong IT-driven smart logistics capabilities. Its patented non-cash cash-on-delivery system and ISO27001 information security certification enhance customer trust. The company’s integration of warehousing, logistics, and delivery services provides clients with one-stop supply chain solutions, while its commitment to green logistics and sustainability further differentiates it in the market.
